{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove $, convert to float, and handle non-numeric
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Ensure 'converted' is boolean
sales_df['converted'] = sales_df['converted'].astype(bool)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] != 'refunded']

# Focus on returning and new customers (intended audience)
email_target = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']
email_target = email_target[email_target['customer_segment'].isin(['returning', 'new'])]

# Compute conversion rate for email campaign among returning and new customers
conversion_rate_email = email_target.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Compute average revenue per converted order for email campaign among returning and new customers
avg_revenue_email = email_target[email_target['converted']].groupby('customer_segment')['revenue'].mean()

# Now, get the baseline conversion rates for returning and new customers in the paid_search channel (the control)
control_target = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']
control_target = control_target[control_target['customer_segment'].isin(['returning', 'new'])]
conversion_rate_control = control_target.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Compute average revenue per converted order in control
avg_revenue_control = control_target[control_target['converted']].groupby('customer_segment')['revenue'].mean()

# Compute treatment effect (email - control) for conversion rate and revenue
conversion_diff = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_control
revenue_diff = avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_control

# Report findings
(conversion_rate_email, conversion_rate_control, conversion_diff, avg_revenue_email, avg_revenue_control, revenue_diff)"}
